sources.title: BBMP Property Tax System — Online Grievance
sources.notes: Public grievance page observed without submission; it requires authenticated/case-specific fields to continue.

claims.text: The public BBMP Property Tax System grievance form lists owner-name correction or update in a receipt as a selectable subject.
claims.notes: Selectable grievance subject, not a triggered error; no grievance was submitted.

edges.label: The public lookup shows a missing-property instruction, but the route did not open a separate public form during observation.
